limits.en: 6,000+ Stroke Rounded icons, web app access, dev formats, free design & dev plugins.

keyLimits.en: 6,000+ icons (Stroke Rounded style only), web app and free plugins.
60,000+ icons across 10 styles, 300K monthly pageviews, 2GB monthly bandwidth, up to 6 project icon sets, custom icon upload, Figma source files, priority support. Billed at $99/year.
Lifetime access: 60,000+ icons across 10 styles, 900K lifetime pageviews, 4GB lifetime bandwidth, up to 500 custom icon uploads, up to 10 project icon sets.

addOns.en: Extra bandwidth at $1/GB and extra pageviews at $3 per 300K views beyond plan limits.

cautions.en: Pro plan usage is metered by pageviews and bandwidth, with overage fees if a project exceeds its monthly allowance.

capabilities.en: Library of 51,000+ professional UI icons across multiple styles (stroke, solid, duotone, etc.) for designers and developers.
Provides ready-to-use dev formats (React, CDN) and design plugins for direct integration into codebases and design tools.
Supports custom icon uploads so teams can host their own icon sets alongside the library.

limitations.en: Free plan is restricted to a single icon style (Stroke Rounded) and a subset of the full library (6,000+ of 51,000+ icons).
Pro plan usage is capped by monthly pageviews and bandwidth, requiring paid overage or upgrade for high-traffic projects.
